stateFields.name: phase

stateFields.name: accountBalance
stateFields.description: Available balance keyed by currency code (golden master: Map[String, Money]).

stateFields.name: reservedAmount
stateFields.description: Prepared reservations keyed by transaction identity (golden master keys reservations by transferId).

stateFields.name: incomingCredits
stateFields.description: Recorded incoming credits keyed by transaction identity (golden master: Map[Id, Money]).

stateFields.name: committed
stateFields.description: Durable commit-phase marker keyed by transaction identity: every commit confirmation puts the txid with the exact committed amount (phase-marker convention, SCHEMA.md P5); the evidence carrier for commit idempotency queries.

stateFields.name: compensated
stateFields.description: Durable compensate-phase marker keyed by transaction identity: every compensate confirmation puts the txid with the exact released amount (phase-marker convention, SCHEMA.md P5); the evidence carrier for compensate idempotency queries.

stateFields.name: sagaResults
stateFields.description: Saga outcome ledger keyed by transaction identity: the idempotent RecordResult* publication commands put the terminal kind here (result-publication convention, SCHEMA.md P5); map-absent guard makes republication an empty success.

commands.name: GetBalance
commands.description: Read-only state view for durable evidence queries (golden master GetBalance). Declares no guards and produces no events: the query-command convention (SCHEMA.md) has generators emit the whole-state reply GetCreditBalanceStateReply(state), whose keyed reservedAmount/incomingCredits maps carry the transaction identity needed for exact prepared-evidence determination (contains(txid)); the golden master's flattened confirmation lists are a display view.

events.name: ReserveFundsConfirmed
events.description: Designed durable fact: funds of the exact amount were reserved under the transaction identity (golden master FundsReserved(transferId, amount)); the state fold keys the reservation by txid.

events.name: DeductFundsConfirmed
events.description: Designed durable fact: the reserved funds under this transaction identity were deducted; the fold clears the entry the txid names.

events.name: ReleaseReservedFundsConfirmed
events.description: Designed durable fact: the reservation under this transaction identity was released; the fold refunds the reserved amount it names back to the balance.

events.name: RecordIncomingCreditsConfirmed
events.description: Designed durable fact: incoming credits of the exact amount were recorded under the transaction identity; the state fold keys the entry by txid.

events.name: CommitIncomingCreditsConfirmed
events.description: Designed durable fact: the recorded incoming credits under this transaction identity were committed; the fold books the recorded amount into the balance and clears the entry.

events.name: CancelIncomingCreditConfirmed
events.description: Designed durable fact: the incoming credits under this transaction identity were canceled; the fold clears the entry the txid names.

events.name: TransferRequested
events.description: Designed durable fact; runtime and serializer evidence must be supplied separately.

events.name: result-succeeded
events.description: Designed durable fact: the saga terminated with outcome succeeded for this transaction identity; the fold records the kind in the sagaResults ledger.

events.name: result-rejected-before-effects
events.description: Designed durable fact: the saga was rejected before any participant effect for this transaction identity; the fold records the kind in the sagaResults ledger.

events.name: result-compensated
events.description: Designed durable fact: the saga compensated all prepared effects for this transaction identity; the fold records the kind in the sagaResults ledger.

events.name: result-recovery-required
events.description: Designed durable fact: the saga ended in RecoveryRequired (unknown outcome) for this transaction identity and awaits authorized reconciliation; the fold records the kind in the sagaResults ledger.

events.name: result-outcome-unknown
events.description: Designed durable fact: the saga outcome could not be classified for this transaction identity and awaits authorized manual evidence; the fold records the kind in the sagaResults ledger.

sagas.name: Transfer exact money between two accounts

payload.purpose: Designed 2026-10-22 under approved #197, derived from the independent saga-money-transfer v1 tree: exact two-account transfer with explicit singleton serial barriers. New design, not a historical note or observed runtime payload. v2 intentionally limits admission to one in-flight step, one attempt, no backoff and equal phase/query timeouts; v1 concurrency and retries are unchanged.
invariants: Currency and exact minor units are conserved
